projects.title: AWS S3 → Lambda → RDS Data Pipeline
projects.objective: A serverless AWS proof-of-concept that automatically records details of every file uploaded to an S3 bucket in a MySQL database.
projects.business_problem: When files arrive in cloud storage, teams need an automatic, reliable record of what arrived and when, without someone logging uploads by hand or keeping a server running.
workflow: A file is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket.
The S3 ObjectCreated event triggers an AWS Lambda function.
The Lambda function, written in Python, extracts the file's metadata: filename, file size, and upload time.
The metadata is inserted into a MySQL database on Amazon RDS.
CloudWatch is used to monitor the Lambda execution through logs.
projects.technical_implementation: Event-driven design: an S3 ObjectCreated event notification invokes a Python Lambda function, which reads the event, extracts metadata, and writes a row to RDS MySQL. IAM permissions control what the function may access, and CloudWatch logging is used for monitoring.
skills_demonstrated: Writing to a relational database from code

projects.title: AWS Public Application + Private Database VPC
projects.objective: A secure AWS network design where users can reach an application from the internet while the application server and database stay private.
projects.business_problem: Applications must be reachable by users, but servers and databases exposed directly to the internet are a security risk. This architecture gives public access through one controlled entry point only.
projects.architecture: Internet → ALB → Private EC2 → Private RDS MySQL. Security group chain: ALB-SG → App-SG → RDS-SG
workflow: A VPC is set up with public and private subnets.
An internet-facing Application Load Balancer sits in the public subnets and is the only public entry point.
The EC2 application server runs in a private subnet and receives traffic only from the load balancer.
The RDS MySQL database runs in a private subnet with public access disabled.
Security groups are chained so the ALB can talk to the application, and only the application can talk to the database.
projects.technical_implementation: Network isolation using public and private subnets, with security group chaining (ALB-SG → App-SG → RDS-SG) so each layer accepts traffic only from the layer in front of it. Database public access is disabled.

projects.title: Databricks E-commerce Data Pipeline
projects.objective: An e-commerce data pipeline following a Bronze, Silver, and Gold architecture for data ingestion, transformation, quality checks, and analytics.
projects.business_problem: Raw e-commerce data is not ready for reporting. It has to be ingested, cleaned, and checked for quality in stages before it can feed trustworthy dashboards.
projects.architecture: Raw → Bronze → Silver → Gold → Power BI
workflow: Raw data is ingested into the Bronze layer.
Data is cleaned and transformed into the Silver layer, with SQL analysis and data quality checks.
Analytics-ready tables are built in the Gold layer.
Power BI is used for reporting on the Gold layer.
projects.technical_implementation: Layered (medallion) pipeline in Databricks using Python and SQL: ingestion and transformation, SQL analysis and data quality checks, then Gold-layer analytics and BI reporting.

Clean inconsistent data and standardize columns.
Analyze affected populations and agricultural impact.
Create visual reports and dashboards.
projects.technical_implementation: Data compiled in Excel, cleaned and standardized with Python and Pandas, then visualized in reports and Power BI dashboards.

projects.title: RAG PDF Question Answering
projects.objective: An AI-powered Retrieval-Augmented Generation application that lets users ask questions about PDF documents and retrieves relevant information from them.
projects.business_problem: Finding a specific answer inside long PDF documents is slow when done by reading or keyword search.
projects.architecture: PDF → loading and chunking → embeddings → vector search → retrieval → LLM response
workflow: Document loading and chunking
Embeddings and vector search
Retrieval and LLM response generation
projects.technical_implementation: Python application that loads and chunks PDFs, creates embeddings, searches them with vector search, and passes the retrieved text to an LLM to generate the answer. The specific LLM and vector store are not named in the portfolio.
